verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say Marlin auto-generates a structured deliverable: a main body, appendices, and references, plus a detailed report of up to ~100 pages and executive summary slides in PowerPoint. The docs also describe structured strategic options as "ready for executive review," which covers the sections, summary, and stakeholder-presentation parts of the story. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of tables in the report, no documentation of report export/sharing formats beyond PowerPoint slides, and no independent hands-on corroboration (all evidence is vendor-hosted, including testimonials).
